name: Datsubo Kan
source:
My mother ran away with another man, leaving me behind when I was young.
She was now living happily with her new family, pretending like what she'd done had never happened.
The son's reunion with the mother who abandoned him lead to a disturbing relationship between mother and child.
「You can't...... You can't do this with your own parent...... Please stop...... Please...... understand.」
Even a mother who initially resists her son, if she starts craving his cock as a woman, will eventually--
「I want you to make me cum... I don't care if I'm a failure as a mother! I want to cum from my son's dick! Dick♪ Dick♪ Dick♪ Please make me cum with your cock!」
--be reduced to a nympho bitch who wants her son to fuck her everyday.
translation: 我的母亲在我很小的时候就和别的男人跑了，把我丢在了身后。她如今与新家庭幸福地生活着，仿佛自己做过的那些事从未发生过。被抛弃的儿子与母亲的重逢，引发了一段令人不安的母子关系。“不可以……你不能对自己的亲生母亲做这种事……求你停下……求你……理解一下。”即使是最初抵抗儿子的母亲，一旦作为女人开始渴望他的肉棒，最终也会——“我想让你让我高潮……我不管自己是不是个失败的母亲！我想用儿子的鸡巴高潮！鸡巴♪鸡巴♪鸡巴♪请用你的肉棒让我高潮！”——沦为一个每天都想被儿子操的荡妇。
